title: Classic Start
description: the session surface's FRONT DOOR — the hero composer with its draft/attachment persistence and slash + file + argument completions, the Project · Work control strip, its two popover menus, and the placed-widget spacer that centres the hero. Ships the shipped implementation (START_CLASSIC) from @fraym/ui rather than a reduced lookalike, so a fully marketplace-assembled space is byte-identical to the built-in one. Fills the `start` contract: a SECTION of the session surface like `thread` and `composer`, resolved inside the surface and never as a layout column. Says the SPACE's words — the hero line comes from the space definition's `workspace.startCopy`, not from this pack and not from the kit.
